hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
If condition flag v2 is up this frame, then choose state 12 next and stop.
Let v3 be the items x in list where part x of the enemy is alive.
If the length of v3 is at most the numeric entry "octo_reach_num_to_revive" in the battle settings of the enemy and the current form of part is "01", then
  Part changes to form "02".
  Part cancels its cast.
Otherwise, if the length of v3 is at least the numeric entry "octo_reach_num_to_normal" in the battle settings of the enemy and the current form of part is "02", then
  Part changes to form "01".
  Part cancels its cast.
For each x in list
  Let part2 be part x of the enemy.
  If part2 is alive, then
    Let v4 be the items x2 in list except where x is x2.
    Let v5 be every x2 in v4 where part x2 of the enemy is dead.
    Let v6 be any x2 in v4 where part x2 of the enemy is alive.
    If v5 and the current form of part2 is data at x at 0's 'paramSuffixNo', then
      Part2 changes to form data at x at 1's 'paramSuffixNo'.
      Part2 cancels its cast.
    Otherwise, if v6 and the current form of part2 is data at x at 1's 'paramSuffixNo', then
      Part2 changes to form data at x at 0's 'paramSuffixNo'.
      Part2 cancels its cast.
  If part2 is ready to act, then part2 picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
If part is ready to act, then part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
